personal-portfolio.summary: A bilingual personal portfolio built as a static Next.js App Router application, with English and Portuguese routes, validated content, and generated CV PDFs.
personal-portfolio.impact: Brings internship experience, skills, and future work into one maintainable portfolio.
personal-portfolio.overview: This portfolio is a focused home for my work, designed to make the story behind each project as clear as the final result. It is statically exported for dependable hosting while still providing a localized, app-like browsing experience.
contributions: Designed a content model that separates shared project data from translated editorial content.
Built locale-aware navigation and static routes for English and Portuguese visitors.
Added validation and automated CV generation to keep the published content consistent.

real-estate-platform.summary: An internship team project for a real-estate website with authentication, profiles, property listings, map and list views, and user-defined filters.
real-estate-platform.impact: Applied ASP.NET Core MVC, Razor Pages, Bootstrap, session state, and Git to a domain-specific web application.
real-estate-platform.overview: Built during an internship as part of a team, this project explored the real-estate journey from sign-in to discovery. The product brings listings, profiles, maps, and filters together so visitors can narrow a large catalogue into useful options.
contributions: Worked with ASP.NET Core MVC and Razor Pages in a collaborative, Git-based workflow.
Contributed to authenticated experiences, user profiles, and property-listing views.
Helped shape filtering and map/list exploration around practical real-estate search needs.

traffic-light-system.summary: A four-way traffic-light model designed in FreeCAD, 3D printed, wired with LEDs, and controlled with an Arduino Mega.
traffic-light-system.impact: Combined modeling, printing, electronics, cable management, and programming in a functional physical prototype.
traffic-light-system.overview: This physical prototype turns a four-way junction into a compact, working system. The project brought digital modelling, fabrication, electronics, and embedded programming into one build that could be tested in the real world.
contributions: Modelled the traffic-light parts in FreeCAD and prepared them for 3D printing.
Wired LEDs and managed the physical connections around an Arduino Mega.
Programmed the light sequence and tested the system as a complete prototype.
